title: DECISION: two-level receiptSharing hierarchy (account + per-chat)
description: receiptSharing is specified at two levels: PresenceStatus.receiptSharing (account-wide default, Boolean, always present) and Chat.receiptSharing (per-chat override, optional Boolean). The per-chat value takes precedence when present; the account-level value is the fallback. This matches how users actually think about privacy: one global default with exceptions for specific conversations. The alternative of only account-level is too coarse — a user may want receipts on for close contacts but off for casual acquaintances. The alternative of only per-chat requires clients to set every chat explicitly and makes the common case (global preference) verbose. The two-level model is the right granularity for a messaging protocol.
